verdict.rationale: Fin ships an analytics layer: Insights analyzes every Fin and human conversation, and the plan includes AI Topics, Trends, AI Recommendations and Monitors. That plausibly supports finding where Fin misses or fumbles questions and improving it. However, no evidence explicitly says it identifies knowledge-base gaps or detects conflicting or contradictory content. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of knowledge-gap detection, conflicting-content detection, linkage from failed answers to specific content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
